demo.aClickWithoutMovementUnder: A click without movement (under 4 px) selects the card; the four side-midpoint anchors are invisible geometry and the edge snaps to the nearest pair. Drag the notepad or the photo: it follows the pointer one to one and the zone shows what a release would do — a dashed slot where the item lands, the other item making room, the frame shrinking around the remaining item when you pull one out. Release over the other free item to group both into a new zone (above/below stacks, left/right places side by side); release away from the zone to keep the item free. Nothing is committed before the release, and every settle uses the same calm ease-out. Click the zone name in its header to rename it: Enter keeps the new name, Escape restores the old one, an empty name returns to the default; a zone formed by grouping starts as “New zone”. Drag a zone by its frame or header to move it together with its items. Click any object to select it and drag one of its eight handles to resize it; a photo dropped into a zone takes the size of the other item. Dragged objects snap to their neighbours (Shift moves freely); Shift-drag on the empty canvas selects several objects; right-click opens the menu, Delete removes, Cmd/Ctrl+Z undoes. When both items are out the empty zone fades away; toolbar, zone and zoom pill are preview-only: a tool click only selects it and changes nothing on the canvas.

demo.twoNoteCardsAndOne: Two note cards and one connection, plus a preview-only toolbar and a zone whose notepad and photo can be pulled out and docked back. The zone lays its two items side by side or stacked depending on where you drop them, a drag follows the pointer one to one, and a docked item can be reordered inside the zone. When both items are out the empty zone disappears, and dragging the two items together forms a new zone around them. Drag a card with mouse, pen or finger — the whole card is the handle — or focus a card and use the arrow keys (16 px per step, Home resets both). interactive demo — not the engine; no data, no server.

masthead.aStaticDesignPreviewOf: A static design preview of the Project air canvas design system: tokens, type, motion, layers, icons, component states, the canvas chrome of the engine, the contract 0.3.0 overview and a sample board, plus a live demo with notes, a zone, a checklist and a table card. This page is not the product — it runs no engine, no data and no server; the demo at the top is illustrative only.

contract.containmentNote: Since 0.2.0 a card or block may name a zone of the same board as its parent (nullable zoneId, no nested zones); the fixtures and test/containment.test.mjs hold the rule, the platform database enforces it.
contract.reorderNote: New in 0.2.0: reorder moves one card, block or zone to a new fractional z; its inverse carries the previous key (L13, the front of a layer).
contract.syncRules030: Since 0.3.0 the contract version is negotiated once per connection (hello first, welcome answers), a fresh board starts at serverSeq 1 with an empty catch-up from 0, and snapshotRef is <boardId>:<serverSeq>.

motion.title: Motion, interaction and layers
motion.intro: Durations, thresholds and the stacking order the canvas and its chrome share. Things move with transform and opacity only, never with springs; under reduced motion every transition is 0 ms (design law §7). Point at a duration to play it.
motion.layersNote: From packages/ui-kit/layers.ts (design law §8); nothing above 10 without an entry there.
chrome.headerNote: 40 px band in faint with a hairline rule; the name is one line with an ellipsis; the delete button stays invisible until hover, focus or selection (L02).
chrome.selectionNote: A 1 px accent frame per selected object, eight 8 px handles on a single selection, and one count bar with a delete button above the group (L10, L14).
chrome.bandNote: Shift-drag on the empty canvas: a soft accent fill with a 1 px accent border; on release every touched object is selected (L10).
chrome.snapNote: Edges and centres within 6 screen px snap; at most three 1 px accent guides, 16 px past both objects; Shift moves freely (L07).
chrome.highlightNote: A drop with the centre inside a zone makes the object a member; the zone is outlined in accent-line for one second (L08).
chrome.undoNote: After an undo the bottom-centre slot shows what was undone for 3 s; no toast queue, no layout shift (L11, design law §9).
chrome.menuNote: Right-click, Shift+F10 or the menu key: 200 px wide, 32 px rows, shortcuts right-aligned in muted; arrow keys, Enter and Esc (L12).
chrome.title: Canvas chrome from the engine
chrome.intro: What the engine draws around the content since engine core (stage 5): quiet and thin, in the accent only where it marks a selection, a snap or a drop. The specimens are static and built from the same tokens.
